verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Treasury APIs for holding balances, moving money (OutboundPayments), and recording transactions. It also mentions platform-built controls on outbound money movement, a general fraud-control feature. None of it documents scoped agent credentials with amount caps or counterparty allowlists, or an agent use case named by the vendor. The general Stripe MCP server and CLI are adjacent developer building blocks and are not evidence of policy-bounded agent account operation.
